MINUTES

  ADJOURNED CITY COUNCIL MEETING

  DECEMBER 12, 2017

An adjourned meeting of the City Council of Rolling Hills Estates was called to order at 5:40
p.m. in the City Council Chamber, 4045 Palos Verdes Drive North, by MAYOR ZERUNYAN.

City Council Members Present:  Huff*, Mitchell, Schmitz, Zerunyan and Zuckerman
  Arrived at 5:49 p.m.
City Council Members Absent:  None.

City Staff Present:  Assistant City Manager Greg Grammer
  Planning Director David Wahba
  Administrative Services Director Mike Whitehead
  Community Services Director Andy Clark
  Assistant to the City Manager Alexa Davis
  City Clerk Heidi Luce

Others Present:  Doug Jensen, Senior Vice President, MuniServices

DISCUSSION ITEM: WORKSHOP ON BUSINESS LICENSE ORDINANCE REVISIONS

Recommendation: That the City Council: 1) Review the proposed ordinance and fiscal analysis
at the adjourned workshop; and 2) Formally consider the proposed ordinance and fiscal
analysis at the regular Council meeting and provide direction.

Assistant City Manager Grammer provided a staff report (as per agenda material) noting that
the primary purpose of the proposed revisions to the business license ordinance are to simplify
and streamline the business license process.

The City Council heard a presentation from Doug Jensen, MuniServices providing the fiscal
analysis of the proposed business license ordinance. He noted that the proposed process is
streamlined and reduces the number of classifications with the objective to make it easier to
administer. He reviewed the current and proposed rates as well as a comparison of nearby cities
rates noting that Rolling Hills Estates is still at the lower end of the range.

Council members discussed the importance of getting input from the business community before
moving the ordinance forward.

Additional discussion ensued concerning the business license rates in neighboring cities, the
various business license categories, how to classify consultants and the differences between the
current rates compared to the proposed rates with COUNCIL suggesting that staff create a simple
chart to show the difference.

ADJOURNED  1
CITY COUNCIL MINUTES
DECEMBER 12, 2017
 Following the presentation and discussion, the City Council created a subcommittee consisting
of MAYOR PRO TEM HUFF and COUNCILMEMBER MITCHELL to work with the Chamber of
Commerce on outreach to the business community and to review proposals from two consultants
to assist with public outreach. Staff was further directed to prepare the final ordinance for
consideration at the January 23, 2018 City Council meeting.

ADJOURNMENT

At 6:37 p.m., MAYOR ZERUNYAN formally adjourned the City Council meeting to a regular
meeting scheduled for Tuesday, December 12, 2017 beginning at 7:00 p.m.

Submitted by,  Approved by,

Heidi Luce  Greg Grammer
City Clerk  Assistant City Manager
